title: 第19章 再战！推断！第20章 夺宝！
content_zh:
第十九章再战！推断！
看着那强劲有力的八荒带着急速的风劲向自己破空斩来，感受到敌人那种舍我其谁的气势，右手受了重伤的神剑**，心灵一颤，避无可避的举起左手中的神剑，奋力一挡。
“挡，”令人出乎意料的一幕出现了，神剑与八荒强烈相撞，八荒直接碎成两段，神剑顺势砍上，眼前自己的头颅就要被神剑削掉。八荒男脑袋突然凌空后仰。种种的摔在地上，几丝金发在空中缓缓飘落。看着自己的几缕金发，八荒男额头流下了几滴汗水。还没反应过来。
闪烁着丝丝魔气的暗之殇再次降临与八荒男的头前。本能反应举起八荒阻挡这强力一击的金发男子，在举起八荒后，才突然想起八荒还剩下一般了。根本无法阻挡神剑的威势。
眼看死亡就要降临，八荒男绝望的看着神剑暗之殇的降落。就在这危急的时刻，金发女性发出的雷电术终于迟迟落下。感受着天空中化为雷龙的闪电里透出的危险气息，神剑男没有丝毫的犹豫果断的放弃了杀死金发男子这一决定，快速的收回暗之殇，居于头顶，欲借神剑之力硬抗这一击。
“轰，”又闪电化作的雷龙在遇上暗之殇后，全部消失，没有对神剑男造成一点伤害，但是就这短短的时间，却给了金发男子一个起死回生的机会，双腿奋力后蹬，跳闪出神剑攻击的范围。慌忙的爬起看着眼前手握神剑的男子，金发男子在这一刻终于感觉到了生命的美妙，想到刚才转瞬之间，自己就好像过了几个世纪一般，直到现在双腿稳站余地，金发男子才感觉到一丝温暖和安全。
这边大战激烈，另一边却是悄无声息，叶宇轩凭借着浮光掠影之力。没有被任何人发现，成功的钻进了黑环巨蟒那房屋般大小的头颅，刚一进去，一股血腥的气味传人叶宇轩的鼻子，让他立即有种想吐的感觉。同时滴滴鲜血从他的头顶滴下，滴在他的衣服，脑袋，旁边，看着这肮脏，恐怖的地方，叶宇轩的思想里第一次出现退缩之感。
但想到自己在这里苦苦守候了一天一夜，难道就因为这样一件小事，就这样无功而返吗？还有看着拿到神剑的男子那突然增强的实力，叶宇轩除了嫉妒之外还有一种深深的不安。这样下去自己能够获得前五名吗？自己还能够实现自己的愿望吗？叶宇轩对着自己的内心自问了一遍。
双眼再次变的坚定，大步向着黑环巨蟒脑袋深处走去。越往前进，血腥气味越是浓重，但是自省过的叶宇轩不再畏惧，依旧向前走去，同时双眼不停的张望四周。
5分钟过去了，叶宇轩内心开始有些着急了，按理说这里就这么一点大，看遍全部不要说五分钟了，就连三分钟也用不到，怎么会找不到呢？难道说是黑环巨蟒为了引诱我们杀死黄金比蒙故意说的话？不应该啊，如果是这样，那些忍者又为什么会出现，而且如此的卖命的啥黄金比蒙，连传说中的防御护符都用上了？
虽然不知道那些忍者的智商如何，但是只要不是白痴都不应该做这样亏本的买卖。那么他们又为什么这样做呢？
难道，难道黑环巨蟒给他们看过什么了？如果这个推断是正确的那么他会将这个重要的东西放在哪里呢？什么地方最安全又可以随时用到呢？只有，只有自己的身上。
想到这里叶宇轩忽然精神一振，好似给自己增强自信般，默默的自言自语到：“肯定的，肯定是的，东西一定在他的体内。”但是在哪里呢？脑袋里已经全部查过了，根本没有。
“额，啊，”想不到的叶宇轩双手抱头大喊，不停的摇晃着。拼命的回忆着黑环巨蟒和黄金比蒙之前的对话。“黑环，今天你必须给我一个交代，让我可以回去交差，否则你今天就不用走了，嘿，金蒙，给你面子，叫你一声金大哥......”不是，再往下想：“你的尾巴，是什么时候修复好的，我记得一千年前不是被我彻底打掉了吗？”从此以后我心中只有两个念头一：修复我的尾巴，还有一个是....”等等，等等，你的尾巴，是什么时候修复好的，修复尾巴，修复尾巴，尾巴。叶宇轩口中默默的念着。
在联想到那个娇俏的少女奔去的地方。叶宇轩忽然感觉一切都通了，一切都是那么的顺理成章。
但是相通了之后的叶宇轩，不仅没有丝毫高兴，内心深处反而充满了深深的不安和忧虑，因为那个身材娇俏的少女身影不断的在自己脑中浮现。
想到这里，叶宇轩急切的看了看智能手表上的时间，从自己行动开始到现在已经过去整整7分钟了。虽然看着黑环巨蟒这房屋般大小的头颅，就可以推测出他身体的体积有多大，但是叶宇轩现在要做的是如何赶在少女之前到达黑环巨蟒的尾巴处，取得其身上的灵宝，而不是想对方是否已经获取。
但是想要赶在少女之前达到，叶宇轩还没有任何的思绪，以逸待劳肯定是不行的，从黑环巨蟒的口中透入出的只言片语，叶宇轩完全可以想象出灵宝的强大。
那么现在只有一个方法，赌一把，凭借着自己引以为豪的技能：“浮光掠影。”提升自己的速度。赶在他之前到达，或者直接在黑环巨蟒的身体中相遇，来一场硬战。
想到这里，叶宇轩不再停顿，大吼一声浮光掠影，顿时叶宇轩感觉好像有一股清风托浮着他的双脚，凌空奔跑，身影急速闪动，向着黑环巨蟒的身体跑去。

直接在空中漂浮潜行，没有出现丝毫的声音，当然也没有引起另外三人的注意，直接一头转进了黑环巨蟒的身体中。向着尾巴处急速奔跑而去。

Chapter 19 Fight again! infer!
Seeing the powerful Bahuang slashing towards him through the air with the rapid wind force, feeling the enemy's aura of abandoning me, the sword in his right hand was seriously injured, his heart trembled, he couldn't help but raise the sword in his left hand, and tried his best to block it.
"Block," an unexpected scene appeared. The divine sword collided violently with Bahuang, and Bahuang was broken into two pieces. The divine sword slashed forward, and his head was about to be cut off by the divine sword in front of him. Bahuangnan's head suddenly flew back.种种的摔在地上，几丝金发在空中缓缓飘落。 Looking at some strands of his blond hair, a few drops of sweat dropped from Bahuangnan's forehead. Haven't reacted yet.
闪烁着丝丝魔气的暗之殇再次降临与八荒男的头前。本能反应举起八荒阻挡这强力一击的金发男子，在举起八荒后，才突然想起八荒还剩下一般了。 There is no way to stop the power of the divine sword.
眼看死亡就要降临，八荒男绝望的看着神剑暗之殇的降落。 At this critical moment, the thunder and lightning technique issued by the blond woman finally fell slowly. Feeling the dangerous aura from the lightning that turned into a thunder dragon in the sky, the Excalibur man decisively gave up the decision to kill the blond man without any hesitation. He quickly withdrew the Dark Sword and placed it above his head, hoping to use the power of the Excalibur to resist the blow.
"Boom," the thunder dragons that turned into lightning disappeared after encountering the Dark Sword. They did not cause any harm to the Excalibur man. However, in this short period of time, they gave the blond man a chance to come back to life. He kicked back with his legs and jumped out of the attack range of the Excalibur. He hurriedly got up and looked at the man holding the divine sword in front of him. At this moment, the blond man finally felt the beauty of life. He thought that in just a blink of an eye, it seemed like centuries had passed. It was only now that his legs had room to stand, that the blond man felt a trace of warmth and security.
这边大战激烈，另一边却是悄无声息，叶宇轩凭借着浮光掠影之力。 Without being noticed by anyone, he successfully got into the house-sized head of the black-ringed python. As soon as he entered, a smell of blood spread to Ye Yuxuan's nose, making him immediately feel like vomiting. At the same time, drops of blood dripped from the top of his head, dripping on his clothes, head, and sides. Looking at this dirty and terrifying place, Ye Yuxuan felt a flinch for the first time in his mind.
但想到自己在这里苦苦守候了一天一夜，难道就因为这样一件小事，就这样无功而返吗？ And looking at the sudden increase in strength of the man who got the divine sword, Ye Yuxuan felt a deep uneasiness in addition to jealousy. Can you get into the top five if you continue like this? Can I still realize my wish? Ye Yuxuan asked himself in his heart.
双眼再次变的坚定，大步向着黑环巨蟒脑袋深处走去。越往前进，血腥气味越是浓重，但是自省过的叶宇轩不再畏惧，依旧向前走去，同时双眼不停的张望四周。
Five minutes passed, and Ye Yuxuan began to feel a little anxious. Logically speaking, this place is only so big. It would take less than five minutes to see everything, not even three minutes. How could he not find it?难道说是黑环巨蟒为了引诱我们杀死黄金比蒙故意说的话？ It shouldn't be. If that's the case, why did those ninjas show up and work so hard for the golden Behemoth, even using the legendary defensive talisman?
虽然不知道那些忍者的智商如何，但是只要不是白痴都不应该做这样亏本的买卖。 So why do they do this?
Could it be that the black-ringed python showed them something? If this inference is correct then where would he put this important thing? Where is the safest place and can be used at any time? Only, only on myself.
Thinking of this YeYuxuan suddenly became energetic, as if to increase his self-confidence, and silently muttered to himself: "Of course, of course, the thing must be in his body." But where is it? I have checked everything in my head and there is none.
"Uh, ah," unexpectedly, Ye Yuxuan put his head in his hands and shouted, shaking constantly. He desperately recalled the previous conversation between the black-ringed python and the golden Behemoth. "Heihuan, today you have to give me an explanation so that I can go back to do my job, otherwise you don't have to leave today. Hey, Jin Meng, to give you face, call you Brother Jin..." No, think about it further: "When was your tail repaired? I remember it for a thousand years. Wasn't it completely destroyed by me before? "From now on, I only have two thoughts: one is to repair my tail, and the other is..." Wait, wait, when was your tail repaired? Repair the tail, repair the tail, Ye Yuxuan said silently.
Thinking of the place where that pretty girl ran to. Ye Yuxuan suddenly felt that everything was clear and everything was so logical.
But after being connected, Ye Yuxuan was not only not happy at all, but also filled with deep uneasiness and worry deep in his heart, because the figure of the pretty girl kept reappearing in his mind.
Thinking of this, Ye Yuxuan looked at the time on his smart watch eagerly. A full 7 minutes had passed since he took action. Although looking at the house-sized head of the black-ringed python, one can infer the size of his body, what Ye Yuxuan needs to do now is how to reach the tail of the black-ringed python before the girl and obtain the spiritual treasure on it, rather than wondering whether the other party has already obtained it.
But if he wants to reach it before the girl, Ye Yuxuan has no thoughts yet, and it is definitely not possible to wait for work. From the few words that came out of the mouth of the black-ringed python, Ye Yuxuan can fully imagine the power of Lingbao.
So now there is only one way, take a gamble and rely on the skills that you are proud of: "Glimpses. "Increase your speed. Arrive before him, or meet directly in the body of the black-ringed python for a tough battle.
Thinking of this, Ye Yuxuan no longer paused, and let out a loud roar. Suddenly, Ye Yuxuan felt as if a breeze was lifting his feet, running in the air, his figure flashing rapidly, running towards the body of the black-ringed python.
It floated and sneaked directly in the air without making any sound. Of course, it did not attract the attention of the other three people. It turned directly into the body of the black-ringed python. Running quickly towards the tail.
